#拟合经验分布函数的方法(ecdf)
```{r}
x <- rnorm(50)
n<-length(x)
# 拟合经验分布
Fhat <- ecdf(x)

#给出置信带
alpha<-0.05
eps<-sqrt((1/(2*n))*log(2/alpha))

#得到对应的函数的取值
xx<-sort(x)
Fhat_xx<-Fhat(xx)

#逐元素取值，确保取得0到1范围内的值
lower <- pmax(Fhat_xx-eps,0)
upper <- pmin(Fhat_xx+eps,1)

#绘图
plot(Fhat,main="经验分布函数的DKW置信带")
lines(xx, lower, col="red", lty=2)
lines(xx, upper, col="red", lty=2)
```

#计算统计量后执行检验的检验模板
```{r}
#计算出的统计量
T_value<-3

param1<-NULL
param2<-NULL

alternative<-"two.sided"

if(alternative == "greater"){
  p_value <- 1 - CDF(T_value, param1, param2)
} else if(alternative == "less"){
  p_value <- CDF(T_value, param1, param2)
} else {
  p_value <- 2 * min(
    CDF(T_value, param1, param2),
    1 - CDF(T_value, param1, param2)
  )
}

p_value
```

#常见分布的cdf
```{r}
#正态分布pnorm(x, mean, sd)
#t分布pt(x, df)
#卡方分布pchisq(x, df)
#F分布pf(x, df1, df2)
#伯努利分布pbinom(x, size, prob)
#泊松分布ppois(x, lambda)
#gamma分布pgamma(x,shape=k,rate=lambda) #scale=1/rate  默认是rate，也就是gamma的东西
#beta分布 pbeta(x,shape1,shape2)
```

#常见分布的pdf
```{r}
# 正态分布密度函数 dnorm(x, mean, sd)
dnorm(0, mean = 0, sd = 1)  # 标准正态分布在0处的密度值

# t分布密度函数 dt(x, df)
dt(0, df = 10)  # 自由度为10的t分布在0处的密度值

# 卡方分布密度函数 dchisq(x, df)
dchisq(1, df = 5)  # 自由度为5的卡方分布在1处的密度值

# F分布密度函数 df(x, df1, df2)
df(1, df1 = 5, df2 = 10)  # 分子自由度5，分母自由度10的F分布在1处的密度值

# 二项分布密度函数 dbinom(x, size, prob)
dbinom(3, size = 10, prob = 0.5)  # n=10,p=0.5的二项分布在3处的概率质量

# 泊松分布密度函数 dpois(x, lambda)
dpois(2, lambda = 3)  # 参数λ=3的泊松分布在2处的概率质量

# gamma分布密度函数 dgamma(x, shape, rate)
dgamma(1, shape = 2, rate = 1)  # 形状参数=2，率参数=1的gamma分布在1处的密度值

# beta分布密度函数 dbeta(x, shape1, shape2)
dbeta(0.5, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)  # 形状参数均为2的beta分布在0.5处的密度值
```

#以卡方检验为例给出调用示例
```{r}
T_value <- 12.3
df <- 6

alternative <- "greater"

if(alternative == "greater"){
  p_value <- 1 - pchisq(T_value, df)
} else if(alternative == "less"){
  p_value <- pchisq(T_value, df)
} else {
  p_value <- 2 * min( pchisq(T_value, df), 1 - pchisq(T_value, df) )
}

p_value
```

#比较多个经验分布函数实例
```{r}
# 生成三组数据
set.seed(1)
x1 <- rnorm(50, mean = 0)
x2 <- rnorm(50, mean = 1)
x3 <- rnorm(50, mean = 2)

# 转成 ECDF 函数
F1 <- ecdf(x1)
F2 <- ecdf(x2)
F3 <- ecdf(x3)

# 先画第一条（建立坐标轴）
plot(F1,
     verticals = FALSE, do.points = FALSE,
     col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     main = "Multiple ECDFs",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "F(x)")

# 第二条，加到原图上
plot(F2,
     verticals = FALSE, do.points = FALSE,
     col = "red", lwd = 2,
     add = TRUE)

# 第三条
plot(F3,
     verticals = FALSE, do.points = FALSE,
     col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2,
     add = TRUE)

# 图例
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("Group 1", "Group 2", "Group 3"),
       col = c("blue", "red", "darkgreen"),
       lwd = 2)
```

#国庆作业1.12模拟练习

##比较经验分布与理论分布的模板
```{r}
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)
library(boot)
library(mixtools)

data(geyser)
x <- geyser$duration
n <- 20    # 每次抽样量（生成 mins 时用）
B <- 50    # 重复次数（mins 的长度）
mins<-NULL

# 重现你生成 mins 的过程（如果已经有 mins 可跳过）
for(k in 1:B){ mins<-c(mins,min(sample(x,n,replace = FALSE))) }

# 经验 CDF
F1 <- ecdf(mins)

# 拟合正态参数（基于 mins）
mean1 <- mean(mins)
sd1   <- sd(mins)

# DKW 置信带 (alpha)
alpha <- 0.05
n_obs <- length(mins)                # 构造 ECDF 的样本大小 = B
eps   <- sqrt( (1/(2 * n_obs)) * log(2/alpha) )

# 统一网格 xx，用于绘图与计算
xx <- seq(min(mins), max(mins), length.out = 400)
Fhat_xx <- F1(xx)

# DKW 上下界并裁剪到 [0,1]
lower <- pmax(Fhat_xx - eps, 0)
upper <- pmin(Fhat_xx + eps, 1)

# 理论 CDF（用拟合的正态分布）
theo_cdf <- pnorm(xx, mean = mean1, sd = sd1)

# 绘图：经验 CDF、置信带（阴影）与理论 CDF
plot(xx, Fhat_xx, type = "s", lwd = 2,
     main = "ECDF with DKW confidence band and Normal CDF",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "F(x)", ylim = c(0,1))

# 阴影置信带
polygon(c(xx, rev(xx)), c(upper, rev(lower)),
        col = rgb(0.8,0.8,0.8,0.5), border = NA)

# 再画阶梯 ECDF（覆盖在阴影上）
lines(xx, Fhat_xx, type = "s", lwd = 2)

# 画理论 CDF
lines(xx, theo_cdf, col = "red", lwd = 2)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("ECDF", "DKW band (95%)", "Fitted Normal CDF"),
       col = c("black", rgb(0.8,0.8,0.8,0.5), "red"),
       lwd = c(2, 10, 2), bty = "n", pt.cex = c(1,1,1))

# 判断理论 CDF 是否完全在置信带内（逐点判断）
inside <- (theo_cdf >= lower) & (theo_cdf <= upper)
prop_inside <- mean(inside)   # 在网格点上落入置信带的比例
n_out <- sum(!inside)

cat("DKW eps =", signif(eps,4), "\n")
cat("网格上理论 CDF 落入置信带的比例 =", signif(prop_inside,4), 
    " (", n_out, " 网格点在外)\n", sep="")

# 如果想查看哪些区间超出
if(n_out > 0){
  out_idx <- which(!inside)
  cat("示例：第一个超出点 x =", xx[out_idx[1]],
      "theo=", signif(theo_cdf[out_idx[1]],4),
      "lower=", signif(lower[out_idx[1]],4),
      "upper=", signif(upper[out_idx[1]],4), "\n")
}

```


##最大似然拟合分布方法
```{r}
fit <- fitdistr(x, densfun = "分布名")

fit$estimate      # 参数估计值
fit$sd            # 参数标准误

#常见分布的MLE调用方式
fit <- fitdistr(x, "normal")
fit$estimate
fit <- fitdistr(x, "exponential")
fit <- fitdistr(x, "gamma")
fit$estimate   # 包含 shape 和 rate
fit <- fitdistr(
  x,
  densfun = "beta",
  start = list(shape1 = 1, shape2 = 1)
)
fit$estimate #remark 必须提供初值，否则无法收敛
fit <- fitdistr(x, "lognormal")
fit$estimate    # meanlog, sdlog
#自定义的函数参数拟合
my_pdf <- function(x, a, b) {
  # 例如某个特殊分布
  return( a * exp(-b*x) )
}

fit <- fitdistr(x, my_pdf, start=list(a=1,b=1))

```


##拟合混合分布的方法
```{r}
library("mixtools")
fit <- gammamixEM(x, k=2)
fit$lambda
fit$alpha
fit$beta

#混合正态
set.seed(1)
x <- c(rnorm(200, 0, 1), rnorm(200, 5, 1.5))

fit_normal <- normalmixEM(x, k = 2)

fit_normal$lambda   # mixing proportions
fit_normal$mu       # means
fit_normal$sigma    # sds

x <- c(rgamma(300, shape = 2, scale = 1),
       rgamma(300, shape = 5, scale = 2))

#混合gamma
fit_gamma <- gammamixEM(x, k = 2)

fit_gamma$lambda
fit_gamma$alpha     # shape parameters
fit_gamma$theta     #scale参数 不是rate!!!


#混合beta
fit_beta <- betamixEM(x, k = 2)

fit_beta$lambda
fit_beta$alpha      # alpha parameters
fit_beta$beta       # beta parameters

#混合weibull分布

x <- c(rweibull(300, shape = 1.2, scale = 2),
       rweibull(300, shape = 3, scale = 1))

fit_weibull <- weibullmixEM(x, k = 2)

fit_weibull$lambda
fit_weibull$shape
fit_weibull$scale


```


##拟合后比较并调用模板
```{r}
#拟合混合分布(分支分布)
library("mixtools")
#使用EM算法进行拟合
mix_fit<-normalmixEM(x, k= 2, maxit=5000, epsilon= 1e-08)

pi_hat<-mix_fit$lambda
mu_hat<-mix_fit$mu
sigma_hat<-mix_fit$sigma
#混合分布的最小次序统计量分布函数
F_mix<-function(y){
  F_val<-pi_hat[1]*pnorm(y,mu_hat[1],sigma_hat[1])+
    pi_hat[2]*pnorm(y,mu_hat[2],sigma_hat[2])
  #混合分布的CDF用全概率公式给出
  1-(1-F_val)^n#最小次序统计量的分布
}
F2<-ecdf(x)
# 统一网格 xx，用于绘图与计算
xx <- seq(min(mins), max(mins), length.out = 400)
Fhat_xx <- F2(xx)

# DKW 上下界并裁剪到 [0,1]
lower <- pmax(Fhat_xx - eps, 0)
upper <- pmin(Fhat_xx + eps, 1)

theo_cdf<-F_mix(xx)

# 绘图：经验 CDF、置信带（阴影）与理论 CDF
plot(xx, Fhat_xx, type = "s", lwd = 2,
     main = "ECDF with DKW confidence band and Normal CDF",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "F(x)", ylim = c(0,1))

# 阴影置信带
polygon(c(xx, rev(xx)), c(upper, rev(lower)),
        col = rgb(0.8,0.8,0.8,0.5), border = NA)

# 再画阶梯 ECDF（覆盖在阴影上）
lines(xx, Fhat_xx, type = "s", lwd = 2)

# 画理论 CDF
lines(xx, theo_cdf, col = "red", lwd = 2)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("ECDF", "DKW band (95%)", "Fitted Normal CDF"),
       col = c("black", rgb(0.8,0.8,0.8,0.5), "red"),
       lwd = c(2, 10, 2), bty = "n", pt.cex = c(1,1,1))

# 判断理论 CDF 是否完全在置信带内（逐点判断）
inside <- (theo_cdf >= lower) & (theo_cdf <= upper)
prop_inside <- mean(inside)   # 在网格点上落入置信带的比例
n_out <- sum(!inside)

cat("DKW eps =", signif(eps,4), "\n")
cat("网格上理论 CDF 落入置信带的比例 =", signif(prop_inside,4), 
    " (", n_out, " 网格点在外)\n", sep="")

# 如果想查看哪些区间超出
if(n_out > 0){
  out_idx <- which(!inside)
  cat("示例：第一个超出点 x =", xx[out_idx[1]],
      "theo=", signif(theo_cdf[out_idx[1]],4),
      "lower=", signif(lower[out_idx[1]],4),
      "upper=", signif(upper[out_idx[1]],4), "\n")
}

```
